title: Data Management & Retrieval
summary: This module provides comprehensive functionalities for loading, indexing, storing, and retrieving documents. It encompasses tools for ingesting data from various sources, managing vector stores, and implementing advanced retrieval strategies to efficiently access relevant information.

nodes.label: Load Documents from Sources
nodes.title: Document Loading
nodes.description: Handles the ingestion of raw data from various external sources, converting it into a standardized document format for further processing.

nodes.label: Index & Store Documents
nodes.title: Indexing & Vector Stores
nodes.description: Manages the creation and maintenance of document indexes and vector stores, enabling efficient storage and semantic search capabilities.

nodes.label: Retrieve & Process Documents
nodes.title: Retrieval Mechanisms
nodes.description: Implements diverse strategies for fetching, filtering, and re-ranking documents based on user queries and advanced algorithms.

nodes.label: Raw Data Sources
nodes.title: External Data Sources
nodes.description: Represents various external data sources (e.g., files, databases, APIs) from which documents are loaded.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Input Query
nodes.description: The natural language query or request provided by the user to initiate a document retrieval process.

nodes.label: Retrieved Documents
nodes.title: Final Retrieved Documents
nodes.description: The set of relevant and processed documents returned after the retrieval and filtering stages.

groups.label: Document Ingestion
groups.title: Document Ingestion Pipeline
groups.description: Focuses on bringing external data into the system and preparing it for indexing.

groups.label: Data Storage & Indexing
groups.title: Data Storage & Indexing Core
groups.description: Manages the persistent storage and efficient indexing of documents and their embeddings.

groups.label: Information Retrieval & Processing
groups.title: Information Retrieval & Processing
groups.description: Handles the intelligent fetching and refinement of documents based on user queries.
